memoryScope: WASM linear memory only; excludes JS heap and compiled code.
scope: Actual published Temporal namespace, all16 owned calendars and IANA data. WASM delegates ISO/Instant/PlainTime/calendar/timezone/Duration math, plain/zoned/short-date arithmetic, string parsing and date formatting with16 native calendars and all IANA records; object semantics and host/Intl integration remain JS/TS. Native-data profile removes duplicated TS calendar/IANA tables; hybrid profile retains them. ISO date and zoned workloads use basic reference; no non-ISO throughput claim. Transition cases use512 iterations and128 warmup. Reference temporal-polyfill1.0.7 basic. Partial WASM backend, not full Rust namespace.
method: Eight inputs, parity checked, 3000 warmup +7 samples x10000 calls; TS then WASM with fallback data then WASM with native data only then reference in one process. First native/calendar/timezone calls measured separately after warmed JS/TS; calendar call includes registry validation. Hot operations exclude startup. timeParse/timeAdd read nanosecond; timeRoundFormat includes formatting. Gzip level9, esbuild es2022 minification. Separately compressed module sums and consumer bundles are alternative delivery modes.
